title: Formal degree of principal series of quasi-split groups
summary: Let $\mathcal{G}$ be a quasi-split connected reductive group over a non-archimedean local field $F.$ In this paper, we prove the formal degree conjecture for discrete series representations contained in a principal series of $\mathcal{G}(F)$. We first construct a type for each Bernstein component attached to a principal series representation of $\mathcal{G}(F).$ We then use these types and the local Langlands correspondence for principal series representations defined in [Sol25] to verify the formal degree conjecture.
